greet.speaker: Lorekeeper Spirit
greet.text: A second ledger-shade drifts among the deeper stacks. "One riddle behind you. One before the vault. Are you ready?"
greet.text_zh: 第二個帳冊之影在更深處的書架間飄動。「一個謎題已在你身後，另一個守著寶庫。準備好了嗎？」

choices.text_zh: 你已經知道我的答案了。

riddle.speaker: Lorekeeper Spirit
riddle.text: "I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with the wind. What am I?"
riddle.text_zh: 「我沒有嘴卻能說話，沒有耳朵卻能聆聽。我沒有身軀，卻隨風而活。我是什麼？」

wrong.speaker: Lorekeeper Spirit
wrong.text: The shade's pages fall still. "Close, but no. Listen more carefully."
wrong.text_zh: 書影的頁面靜止了下來。「接近了，但不對。再仔細聽聽。」

correct.speaker: Lorekeeper Spirit
correct.text: "An echo — just so. A voice with no body of its own." The vault door beyond groans and settles open.
correct.text_zh: 「回聲——正是如此。一個沒有自己身軀的聲音。」後方的寶庫大門發出低吟，緩緩開啟。

already_solved.speaker: Lorekeeper Spirit
already_solved.text: "An echo. Whatever you find in the vault, it was already answered for."
already_solved.text_zh: 「回聲。無論你在寶庫裡找到什麼，那答案早已為你備妥。」
